description: software-gym Codex agent runtime policy. LoopController should read this file before spawning Codex CLI agents. Model name, base URL and API keys are NOT configured here; they are read from the repo-root .env (MODEL / BASE_URL / OPENAI_BASE_URL / API_KEY / OPENAI_API_KEY / MODEL_PROVIDER).

FunctionDesigner.reason: Designs from the requested software type and local prompt contract without hosted web search.

IconDesigner.reason: Infers the style-agnostic icon semantic superset from the local requirement document only.

SubIconDesigner.reason: Generates one style's SVG icon set from the shared superset and the local style visual system.

StyleDesigner.reason: Designs from the local requirement document and style contract without hosted web search.

SubStyleDesigner.reason: Expands the local requirement and selected style into XAML blueprint without hosted web search.

Coder.reason: Should implement from the local requirement, selected style, blueprint, and prior eval evidence.

DevCoder.reason: Should review and fix the generated local code against the local spec and eval evidence.

EvalTaskGenerateAgent.reason: Should generate comparable GUI cases from the local requirement and feature_matrix only.

GUIAgent.reason: Runs through OSWorld GUI observations rather than Codex CLI web search.

unsupported_web_search_behavior.fallback: Continue without web search, but keep the degraded mode visible in manifest and logs.
